spans.s:
लुट् {vI.v} {c1c} A. (लोटते)
1 To resist,
repel, oppose.
--2 To shine.
--3 To
suffer pain. {vII.v} {c10c} U. (लोटयति-ते)
1 To speak.
--2 To shine. {vIII.v} {1}
{c4c} P. (लोटति, लुट्यति)
1 To roll,
wallow on the ground; cf. लुठ्.
--2
To take away, rob, plunder
(perhaps for लुंठ् or लुंट्).

लुट् A technical term used by
Pāṇini to denote the First or
Periphrastic Future or its
terminations.
